quotas.name: Access Points
quotas.description: The number of Amazon S3 Access Points that you can create per region in an account

quotas.name: Bucket policy
quotas.description: The maximum size (in KB) of a bucket policy for an Amazon S3 bucket

quotas.name: Bucket tags
quotas.description: The maximum number of tags you can assign to an Amazon S3 bucket

quotas.name: Directory buckets
quotas.description: The number of Amazon S3 directory buckets that you can create in an account

quotas.name: Event notifications
quotas.description: The maximum number of event notifications per Amazon S3 bucket

quotas.name: General purpose buckets
quotas.description: The number of Amazon S3 general purpose buckets that you can create in an account

quotas.name: Lifecycle rules
quotas.description: The maximum number of rules you can specify for an Amazon S3 lifecycle configuration

quotas.name: Maximum part size
quotas.description: The maximum size (in GB) of an Amazon S3 object part in a Multipart upload using the API

quotas.name: Minimum part size
quotas.description: The minimum size (in MB) of an Amazon S3 object part in a Multipart upload using the API. The last part uploaded can be less than the stated minimum

quotas.name: Multi-Region Access Point Regions
quotas.description: Maximum Regions per Multi-Region Access Point.

quotas.name: Multi-Region Access Points
quotas.description: Multi-Region Access Points per Account.

quotas.name: Object size
quotas.description: The maximum size (in TB) of an Amazon S3 object

quotas.name: Object size (Console upload)
quotas.description: The maximum size (in GB) of an Amazon S3 object that you can upload using the console

quotas.name: Object tags
quotas.description: The maximum number of tags you can assign to an Amazon S3 object

quotas.name: Parts
quotas.description: The maximum number of Amazon S3 object parts per Multipart upload

quotas.name: Replication Destinations
quotas.description: The number of destination S3 buckets you can add for each source S3 bucket across all replication rules.

quotas.name: Replication rules
quotas.description: The maximum number of rules you can specify in an Amazon S3 Replication configuration

quotas.name: Replication transfer rate
quotas.description: The maximum Replication Time Control transfer rate that you can replicate from the source region in this account.

quotas.name: S3 Glacier: Number of random restore requests.
quotas.description: The number of random restore requests from S3 Glacier storage class per PiB stored per day.

quotas.name: S3 Glacier: Provisioned capacity units
quotas.description: The maximum number of S3 Glacier storage class provisioned capacity units available to purchase per account.

quotas.name: S3 Glacier: Retrieval request rate per second.
quotas.description: The maximum number of retrieval requests per second allowed per account.
